knowledge:
- key_parameters: threshold.over=Guidance: Set in ProcessCels(); determines the relative expression threshold above which probes are considered overexpressed (default is 1.5 times the median). ;; threshold.under=Guidance: Set in ProcessCels(); determines the relative expression threshold below which probes are considered underexpressed. ;; remove_method=Guidance: Set in ProcessCels(); controls duplicate probe removal (0 = keep all, 1 = keep one probe per gene based on priority list and earliest location, 2 = remove only when linking to the exact same location). ;; chromNum=Guidance: Set in stats and plot functions; specifies the chromosome to analyze (e.g., 17) or "ALL" to test all chromosomes. ;; samples=Guidance: Numeric vector of sample indices to compare against the rest of the dataset. ;; test=Guidance: Statistical test to use, either "fisher" (exact, preferred but slower) or "chisqr" (approximation, faster for large datasets). ;; bonferroni=Guidance: Logical; set to TRUE when testing multiple chromosomes or bands to correct for Type I errors. ;; enrichment=Guidance: Controls which side is tested, typically "greater" for overexpression/gains or "less" for underexpression/losses. ;; k=Guidance: Window size for the sliding average smoother in slidPlot() and facetPlot(). ;; gamma=Guidance: Smoothness parameter for the Potts filter in discontPlot(); higher values result in fewer jumps and flatter segments.
- alternatives: Ben-David et al. approach=The underlying methodology implemented by CAFE for virtual karyotyping. ;; fisher vs chisqr=Fisher's exact test provides exact p-values but is slower for large sample sizes, whereas Chi-Square is faster and increases in accuracy with larger sample sizes.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have Affymetrix microarray gene expression data (.CEL files) and want to identify large-scale chromosomal aberrations (gains/losses) or cytoband-level copy number variations without dedicated CGH/SNP microarrays.
- pitfalls: Only natively supports Affymetrix .CEL files; other platforms (e.g., Illumina) require manual formatting into a complex list-of-lists structure. ;; Failing to set bonferroni=TRUE when testing multiple chromosomes or bands will result in uncorrected p-values and high false-positive rates. ;; The order of probes and locations in custom non-Affymetrix data structures must be strictly identical across all samples.

workflows.name: affy_cel_analysis
workflows.intent: Process raw Affymetrix CEL files to identify and visualize chromosomal and cytoband aberrations.
input: .CEL files (raw Affymetrix microarray intensity files stored in a single directory)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the CAFE library and set the working directory containing the CEL files. ;; 2. Process raw CEL files to normalize, log2-transform, and filter probes. ;; 3. Perform chromosome-level statistical testing for gains or losses. ;; 4. Perform cytoband-level statistical testing to identify specific aberrant bands. ;; 5. Generate raw, sliding average, discontinuous (Potts filter), and genome-wide facet plots.
workflows.code:
library(CAFE)
setwd("~/some/path")
datalist <- ProcessCels()
data("CAFE_data")
names(CAFE_data[[2]])
sam <- c(1,3)
chromosomeStats(CAFE_data,chromNum=17,samples=sam,test="fisher",bonferroni=FALSE,enrichment="greater")
chromosomeStats(CAFE_data,chromNum=17,samples=sam,test="chisqr",bonferroni=FALSE,enrichment="greater")
chromosomeStats(CAFE_data,chromNum="ALL",samples=sam,test="fisher",bonferroni=TRUE,enrichment="greater")
bandStats(CAFE_data,chromNum=17,samples=sam,test="fisher",bonferroni=TRUE,enrichment="greater")
p <- rawPlot(CAFE_data,samples=c(1,3,10),chromNum=17)
print(p)
p <- slidPlot(CAFE_data,samples=c(1,3,10),chromNum=17,k=100)
print(p)
p <- discontPlot(CAFE_data,samples=c(1,3,10),chromNum=17,gamma=100)
print(p)
p <- facetPlot(CAFE_data,samples=c(1,3,10),slid=TRUE,combine=TRUE,k=100)
print(p)
